title: Mediation
description: Definition of Mediation under the Consumer Protection Act, 2019

content.legal_definition: the process by which a mediator mediates the consumer disputes
content.plain_language: a process where a neutral person helps resolve consumer disputes
examples: a consumer and a company using a mediator to settle a complaint
a mediator facilitating a discussion between a buyer and a seller to resolve a dispute
non_examples: a direct negotiation between two parties without a neutral third party

user_queries: what is mediation in consumer law
how does mediation work in consumer disputes
what is the purpose of mediation in consumer protection
